# Demo Selenium TypeScript for Google Search

> A beginner-friendly, TypeScript, real-assertion demo describing Selenium WebDriver browser automation against the live Google Search website. Never executed against the live site by this repo's own tooling — see the Google Terms of Service caution in README.md and AGENTS.md.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Install and run instructions, and the Google Terms of Service caution.
- [Spec](spec/index.md): Exact scenario specification — the three assertions, selectors, and expected strings.
- [Citation](CITATION.cff): Citation metadata for this software.

## Source

- [demo.ts](src/demo.ts): The demo script itself.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent instructions pointer (loaded by CLAUDE.md), including the non-negotiable policy against live execution.
